properties.statement:
WHAT ACTUALLY PAID OFF, IN TWO REAL DESIGNS, ON ONE DAY — recorded because reflow2 collects friction diligently and evidence of USE almost not at all (only ~11% of capabilities have any recorded consumer, and a report that only ever lists debt reads as a hygiene tool).

① **detect_defects caught two architecture cycles before a line of code existed** (musicjug). `comp:coach -> comp:shell -> comp:coach`, severity critical, fixed; then `comp:shell -> comp:stage -> comp:shell`. "Same mistake, made twice, minutes apart, by me, unnoticed both times." Cost to catch at design time: ~4 minutes. The session's own verdict: "the second one is what convinced me the first wasn't luck." It then wrote the rule down (`dec:shell-is-the-composition-root`) so a third one does not get built — a detector that changes the RULES rather than only the graph.

② **The absence doctrine changed behaviour, in the exact words it was built to say** (musicjug). "the component level has 7 component(s) and ZERO dependency pairs between them, so every topology result here is silent about that level rather than clean about it." The session had just received a clean sweep, and that sentence told it the clean sweep meant nothing. It declared twelve component dependencies BECAUSE OF THAT LINE — which is what made ① possible at all. "Almost every analysis tool in existence reports '0 findings' identically whether it looked hard and found nothing or couldn't have found anything. This should be copied by other tools." THE HEADLINE FINDING DEPENDED ON THE ABSENCE FINDING.

③ **quality_target_unstated changed the architecture** (musicjug). Forcing "which would you sacrifice the others for?" before allocation got the answer "timing", and because of it rendering and touch input were fused into one component with one clock as sole time authority — "a shape I would not have chosen by default." What made it answerable by a non-specialist owner in one click was the gap text spelling out how the four attributes actually disagree.

④ **budget_report produced a conclusion the owner has to act on** (bhome, part 8) — the first tool in that session to do so rather than record a conclusion he had already reached. `total: 297, limit: 250, verdict: "exceeded", unstated: [], basis_coverage: {estimated: 10}`. Three details make it trustworthy rather than tidy: `unstated: []` licenses reading 297 as a real total; `estimated: 10` stops anyone mistaking it for survey data; `path_note` explained why it did not compute the other rollup it can compute. Cost: ten edges with a number on each.

⑤ **Retirement worked end to end without management** (bhome, part 5). OBSOLETES drawn from the accepted Decision that withdrew the thing; only an ACCEPTED Decision discontinues anything; the target's `status` deliberately does not move. After the retirement the gap count stayed at 3 — the discontinued capability's findings fell silent on their own and nothing started nagging. "The alternative I would have reached for unaided — delete_node — is precisely what the orphan_node repair note calls out."

⑥ **`proposed` + an approver models "I recommend this, but it is not mine to decide"** (musicjug). The agent recorded its own architectural recommendation, left it unsettled, attached the owner as approver; `loop_status` reported it under `assigned_decisions` and kept reporting it until answered. "I did not have to remember to ask, and I could not accidentally record my recommendation as their decision. I have not seen another design tool that models this as a first-class state. For agent-driven work this is close to essential."

⭐ AND ONE ON INSTRUCTION DESIGN, WHICH IS ITSELF A MEASUREMENT: both reports independently say that instructions carrying their own EVIDENCE got followed and bare instructions did not. musicjug: "'on 2026-08-21 reflow2's own graph held 145 brainstormed ideas joined by 12 edges' is why I actually drew the relations instead of skipping to the next step. An instruction with a measurement attached gets followed. An instruction that says 'remember to link things' does not." bhome, on the Constraint-not-Requirement routing: "'Constraint is not only for budgets' as a bare statement would have washed over me. 'Eleven prohibitions in a real design now report unsatisfied forever' is specific enough to change behaviour." Two observers, same conclusion, about the house style of every skill here.
